args: const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),os=require("os"),url=require("url");const base=path.join(process.env.CODEX_HOME||path.join(os.homedir(),".codex"),"plugins","cache");let best;for(const market of fs.readdirSync(base)){const dir=path.join(base,market,"parley");if(!fs.existsSync(dir))continue;for(const version of fs.readdirSync(dir)){const file=path.join(dir,version,"parley.mjs");try{if(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,version,"package.json"),"utf8")).name!=="parley-plugin")continue;const at=fs.statSync(file).mtimeMs;if(!best||at>best.at)best={file,at};}catch{}}}if(!best){console.error("Parley: no installed parley plugin under "+base);process.exit(1);}process.argv=[process.argv[0],best.file,...process.argv.slice(1)];import(url.pathToFileURL(best.file).href);
